request.prompt:
You are a text-only source-entailment auditor. The source records are authoritative about their limited annotation meanings, NOT proof that the video visibly shows a fact. Compare the proposed QA and the separate blind answer with the exact source contract. Return JSON only. Verify every claim against its cited source_ids. Reject added receivers, causes, required corrections, tool-tip subtype, torque, whole-device completion, or mandatory order not explicitly sourced. Observed starts do not establish completion or prescribed order. ASR=-1 does not imply operator anomaly; an active segment alone may not prove unfinished physical installation. Keep ALL anomaly attributes in a multi-label answer. Questions must not leak their answer, must agree with the MCQ proposition, and each option must be mutually exclusive at the requested scope. A negative yes/no answer may be semantically equivalent to a positive description; compare meaning, not phrasing. If blind answer is uncertain or omits a requested attribute, blind_matches_gt=false. Never infer visual quality yourself.
Return exactly {"source_entails_answer":boolean,"claims_entailed":boolean,"question_preserves_scope":boolean,"open_mcq_equivalent":boolean,"no_answer_leakage":boolean,"unique_correct_option":boolean,"correct_option_index":integer,"blind_matches_gt":boolean,"unsupported_claims":[string],"reason":string}.
correct_option_index is zero based. reason <=60 words; unsupported_claims list the precise unsupported claims, empty only if none. No chain-of-thought.
